"""HTTP wiring. See api/API.md."""
import json
import sys
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

from .handlers import App


def make_server(app=None, host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 0) -> ThreadingHTTPServer:
    app = app if app is not None else App()

    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
        def _serve(self):
            length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
            body = self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
            status, payload = app.handle(self.command, self.path, body)
            data = json.dumps(payload).encode()
            self.send_response(status)
            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
            self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(data)))
            self.end_headers()
            self.wfile.write(data)

        do_GET = do_POST = _serve

        def log_message(self, format, *args):
            pass

    return ThreadingHTTPServer((host, port), Handler)


def start(app=None, host: str = "127.0.0.1", port: int = 0) -> tuple[ThreadingHTTPServer, threading.Thread]:
    server = make_server(app, host, port)
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    return server, thread


def main(argv=None) -> None:
    argv = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    port = int(argv[0]) if argv else 8080
    server = make_server(port=port)
    print(f"listening on http://127.0.0.1:{port}")
    server.serve_forever()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main(sys.argv[1:])
